items.title: Adopt a saas identity provider to replace legacy session based authentication
Provisionally adopt conjoined application layer tenancy as the default posture
Adopt marten and wolverine as the dotnet toolchain
Select the client server communication mechanism for asynchronous updates
Default to dynamic consistency boundaries over aggregate scoped streams
Choose the frontend technology stack for chronoshub
Default to result types over exceptions for application flow
Select the mechanism for internal stakeholder data access
Compose read models in the projection layer
Project read models into action ready rows
Handle asynchronous read consistency in the frontend
Translate cross context events only when they become domain facts
Keep processors free of domain logic
Adopt the decider pattern for command handling
